messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick share — a 5-min compact pack for cross-functional goal syncs. Use during 1:1s or pre-OKR reviews. TL;DR: 3-line goal, 2 success signals, 1 dependency, 1 ask. Drop feedback or examples.

Devin (Eng Manager): Love the short format. Can you show a product + infra example so managers can copy/paste? :100:

Maya (People Ops): Sure — here's a copyable example you can paste into notes:```Goal: Reduce embed API 99p latency from ~420ms to <=320ms by EoQ.
Success signals: 1) 99p < 350ms for 2 consecutive weeks; 2) end-to-end error rate < 0.1% rolling 30d.
Dependencies: KV cache rollout (infra), model quantization PR (ML).
Ask: PM to prioritize perf epic in sprint 3; infra to schedule KV rollout by 6/10.```

Sasha (PM): Nice. For self-review prompts can we include a hiring ops line? Hiring always sneaks into goals for my org.

Maya (People Ops): Yep — add a single line under "Ask" called HiringOps where you list roles, ETA, and risk level. Example: `HiringOps: 1 SWE (backend) — shortlist by 6/1, medium risk (competing offers)`.

Oliver (IC): Perfect — I'll use this in my 1:1 prep tonight. Can we also get a 30s manager script to coach this in a check-in? Simple phrasing for managers who want to be efficient.

Maya (People Ops): Manager micro-script (30s):
- Acknowledge impact: "This goal looks focused on latency — great priority."
- Confirm signals: "Which metric will tell us we're succeeding?"
- Surface dependencies: "Who needs to unblock you this sprint?"
- Commit an ask: "I'll escalate the infra dependency and sync on Tues."
Use as-is or paraphrase.

Devin (Eng Manager): Also helpful: a tiny cross-team handoff snippet (RACI-lite) we can paste into tickets:```R: owner (eng), A: PM, C: infra, I: security.
Handoff notes: expected snapshot (perf test link), deployment window, rollback plan.```

people-ops-bot: Template saved to People Ops drive: https://drive.google.com/xxxxxx (folder: "compact-goal-templates"). Pinning to #people-ops. :pushpin:

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — I'll make a one-pager from these examples and add a short checklist for managers (3 bullets). @Devin @Sasha if you have onboarding-specific constraints (like hiring timelines) please DM me; I'll fold them into the checklist before posting in #docs.
